sources.shortCitation: Grammophon B 51823 / Bestell-Nr. 23042, “Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor!”
sources.fullCitation: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester, with German refrain vocal. “Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor!” Fox-trot; label credit “(Rotter-Kaper)”. Grammophon, electrical recording, catalogue B 51823, order no. 23042, side 2, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Accessed 15 August 2026.

sources.date: n.d. [recording year given as 1930 by the uploader]
sources.researchNote: The uploader names Alexander Fleßburg as the refrain singer and gives 1930 as the recording year; neither statement is printed on the filmed label.
